description:
Cast Hada Freeblade by paying {W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Whenever Hada Freeblade enters the battlefield, it and Ondu Cleric trigger.
Resolve the Hada Freeblade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ondu Cleric trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier token, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Hada Freeblade.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hada Freeblade, adding {1}.
When Hada Freeblade dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Hada Freeblade from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
